_comment: Signature set for the sqli and xss rules (RF-03).
This file is versioned separately from the code so signatures can be
updated without recompiling the engine, which is what §8.2 asks for when
it requires periodic rule updates. Point OS_PATTERNS_FILE at a copy of
this file to override it at runtime.
Patterns are Go RE2 syntax: no backreferences, linear time, no catastrophic
backtracking. That matters here — these run on the request path, against
Every pattern is scanned against the path, the query string, header values,
cookies and the (truncated) body, both raw and percent-decoded.

sqli.description: UNION SELECT, the classic column-stealing injection
Quote-escape followed by an always-true comparison, e.g. ' OR '1'='1
OR 1=1 style tautology without quoting (RE2 has no backreferences, so this matches any numeric comparison, not only equal operands)
Statement terminator followed by a second, destructive statement
Quote followed by a comment marker, used to swallow the rest of the query
Time-delay function used for blind injection
Direct reference to a database catalogue
SQL function that reads or writes the host filesystem

xss.description: Closing </script> tag, used to break out of an inline script
Script URI in an attribute such as href or src
Tag that can execute or redirect when injected into a page
DOM access typical of a payload exfiltrating a session
Script executed from a string literal
HTML delivered through a data: URI
